apps.name: Kryoas V1
apps.tagline: Old internal app (4.4.1) · replaced by Kryoas Internal

versions.description: Plans can be edited again: open any .plan file (Plan library → Other plan files…), change it, save it and upload it. TDP plans can be edited too. Every upload still needs the pre-flight form and pilot photo.
In-app updates: Kryoas now tells you when a new version is in the store and updates itself in place, keeping your plans, logs, settings and license.
Synced with the main app: project sync, plan library, Route Loop, pilot photo, flight history by project, TDP zip import, pending missions panel, DEM terrain upload and crash fixes
Internal flying & backup build (no MAVLink signing requirement).

In-app updates: Kryoas now tells you when a new version is in the store and updates itself in place, keeping your plans, logs, settings and license.
